gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-fs-recia: Recia reads sharp and a touch authoritative, its faint stroke modulation only showing up on a close look. Nanum Gothic Coding is the relaxed, pen-drawn voice with a single tubing-like line, while Recia is the one built for steady, generous-opening text.
gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-fs-rowan: Rowan is a friendly, literary serif whose thin strokes run about half the weight of its thick ones. Rowan keeps its curves generously open, so text feels comfortable in small doses beneath the wire-like looseness of Nanum Gothic Coding.
gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-fs-spline-san: Spline Sans reads contemporary and approachable, with wide gaps where its curves meet the stems. Spline Sans does its best work at modest sizes, so give it a little less room than the loose Nanum Gothic Coding heading above.
gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-fs-synonym: Dependable and clean, Synonym lays down a plain stripe of ink with generously opened curves. Synonym is the sturdy partner here, and Nanum Gothic Coding supplies a graceful, hand-drawn looseness that this sans-serif keeps in check.
gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-outfit: Nanum Gothic Coding looks like casual pen lettering, bent from a single length of tubing with graceful, relaxed forms. But Outfit is the one made for short stretches of reading, its sans curves stopping well before they close.
gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-plus-jakarta-: Every letter of Nanum Gothic Coding looks bent from one length of tubing, loose and handwritten. Plus Jakarta Sans handles the precise, modern part, with a monoline build and curve endings held well apart.
gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-sora: Sora is precise and geometric, with no pressure swell at its corners and a widely parted c and s. Yet Nanum Gothic Coding brings the graceful, pen-and-paper looseness, leaving this plain sans to handle brief reading.
gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-space-grotesk: Wide-mouthed, pen-drawn letters bent from a single length of tubing give Nanum Gothic Coding its relaxed look. Space Grotesk's ribbon-like glyphs stay comfortable in small doses.
gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-fs-bespoke-sans: Friendly scrawl with gaping e shapes and tightly compressed spacing, all clearly drawn by hand. Bespoke Sans stays sharp and refined, but it isn't meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-fs-literata: Nanum Pen Script has a tube-like, constant-width stroke, gaping e mouths and a friendly hand-drawn feel. Literata, the bookish serif, is the one made for brief reading, so size it modestly.
